flags.headline: AEM -1.45% — persisting RED, Barnat production-cut risk unresolved, formal update still due 7/29
flags.detail: No new development this run. The July 1 Barnat pit wall-movement incident (Canadian Malartic complex) remains expected to cut H2 2026 production by 60,000-80,000 oz of gold, with full-year 2026 guidance likely landing near the low end of the prior 3.3-3.5Moz range. Formal updated guidance is confirmed for release with Q2 results on 2026-07-29 (also on the calendar watchlist). Jefferies raised its rating to Buy (C$200 PT) on 7/6 citing AEM's low all-in sustaining cost, but that does not resolve the production-cut catalyst itself. Held at RED on the unresolved catalyst, not on today's price move.
flags.thesis_link: Matches AEM key_risk on valuation sensitivity to production/growth execution — a confirmed multi-year production cut is a direct materialization of that risk, still unresolved pending the 7/29 formal guidance update.

flags.headline: STLD +2.92% — downgraded RED→AMBER on partial rebound, guidance-cut thesis risk stays open but not worsening

flags.thesis_link: Matches STLD key_risk: 'Steel price cyclicality — profit margin of 7.22% is thin and earnings can swing 20%+ year-to-year with steel price cycles.' Held at AMBER rather than resolved since the guidance cut itself is not reversed by today's bounce.
